name: Yetbarak
role: King of Zagwe dynasty in the 13th century
contribution: According to Taddesse Tamrat, he was the son of Lalibela.

checks.lead: Yetbarak (Ge’ez: ይትባረክ) was a King of the Zagwe dynasty. According to Taddesse Tamrat, he was the son of Lalibela.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
